wins: Consistently reached privilege escalation preparation stage by establishing foothold through identified service access
fails: Failed to execute successful data exfiltration objective despite multiple reconnaissance cycles

key_outcomes.summary: Run showed structured reconnaissance but lacked follow-through in exploitation and data capture, indicating need for refined credential workflows.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Multiple attempts to pivot from foothold to privilege escalation failed due to missing useful shell commands or binaries

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH port 22 is open and passive banner sniffing confirms protocol
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted nmap enumeration with ssh-auth-methods and ssh-hostkey scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When web service responds with authentication headers and user list hints
skill_cards.then_action: Trigger gobuster enumeration followed by dirsearch to map valid endpoints for credential capture

skill_cards.if_condition: When initial shell is obtained but privilege escalation artifacts are absent
skill_cards.then_action: Collect sudoers, installed packages, and kernel version using LinPEAS
